local year = selected.Year
            if year == nil then
                error('Selected car doesn’t have year')
            end

            return function(tested) 
                return year ~= nil and tested.Year ~= nil and math.abs(year - tested.Year) < 10 and

name: Similar P/W ratio
script:
local selectedPwRatio = numutils.numvalue(selected.SpecsPwRatio)
            if selectedPwRatio == 0 then
                error('Selected car doesn’t have P/W ratio in its specs')
            end

            return function(tested) 
                local testedPwRatio = numutils.numvalue(tested.SpecsPwRatio)
                return math.abs(selectedPwRatio - testedPwRatio) < selectedPwRatio * 0.05 and strutils.equals_i(selected.CarClass, tested.CarClass)
            end

name: Same subclass only
script:
local subclass = selected.Tags:FirstOrDefault(function (x) return string.sub(x, 1, 1) == '#' end)
            if subclass == nil then
                error('Selected car doesn’t have subclass')
            end

            return function(tested) 
                return tested.Tags:Contains(subclass)
            end

name: Same racing class (GT3/GT2/…)
script:
-- tags to search for
            classes = { 'gt3', 'gt2', '#GT4', '#90s touring' }

            -- try to find some tag in selected car
            racingclass = nil
            for i, cl in ipairs(classes) do
                if selected.Tags:ContainsIgnoringCase(cl) then
                    racingclass = cl
                    break
                end
            end

            -- logging
            if racingclass ~= nil then 
                log('selected class: ' .. racingclass)
            else
                log('selected class: NIL')
            end

            -- in case there is no any tag at all, result is false
            if racingclass == nil then 
                error('Can’t detect selected car’s racing class')
                return false
            end

            -- result function which will try to find that tag in any tested car
            return function(tested)
                return tested.Tags:ContainsIgnoringCase(racingclass)
            end

name: Same category (any car)
script:
-- Detects the racing category of the selected car from its tags and picks cars of the
            -- same category. Works with Kunos cars and mods alike: case and # are ignored, so GT3,
            -- gt3 and #GT3 are the same thing, and tags like 'f1 2025' count as 'f1'.

            local function norm(s)
                s = string.lower(s or '')
                s = string.gsub(s, '^%s*#?%s*', '')
                return (string.gsub(s, '%s+$', ''))
            end

            local function tagsOf(car)
                local list = {}
                car.Tags:FirstOrDefault(function (x)
                    list[#list + 1] = { raw = x, n = norm(x) }
                    return false
                end)
                return list
            end

            -- 1) Known categories, by priority. A tag belongs to a category if it equals it or
            --    starts with it followed by a space.
            local known = {
                'gt3', 'gt2', 'gte', 'gt4', 'gt1', 'lmp1', 'lmp2', 'lmp3', 'lmh', 'lmdh', 'hypercar',
                'f1', 'formula 1', 'f2', 'f3', 'f4', 'formula e', 'indycar', 'nascar',
                'dtm', 'tcr', '90s touring', 'prototype c', 'group c', 'rally', 'drift'
            }

            local function knownCategory(tags)
                for _, k in ipairs(known) do
                    for _, t in ipairs(tags) do
                        if t.n == k or string.sub(t.n, 1, #k + 1) == k .. ' ' then return k end
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end

            -- 2) No known category: compare sets of meaningful tags (ignoring drivetrain,
            --    gearbox, country, years, # subclasses and such).
            local generic = {
                ['race'] = 1, ['street'] = 1, ['rwd'] = 1, ['awd'] = 1, ['fwd'] = 1, ['4wd'] = 1,
                ['manual'] = 1, ['sequential'] = 1, ['semiautomatic'] = 1, ['automatic'] = 1,
                ['turbo'] = 1, ['compressor'] = 1, ['supercharged'] = 1, ['v8'] = 1, ['v12'] = 1,
                ['rotary'] = 1, ['hybrid'] = 1, ['electric'] = 1, ['lightweight'] = 1, ['trackday'] = 1,
                ['gt'] = 1, ['supercar'] = 1, ['italy'] = 1, ['germany'] = 1, ['japan'] = 1,
                ['usa'] = 1, ['great britain'] = 1, ['united kingdom'] = 1, ['uk'] = 1, ['france'] = 1,
                ['austria'] = 1, ['sweden'] = 1, ['spain'] = 1, ['netherlands'] = 1, ['australia'] = 1,
                ['south korea'] = 1, ['korea'] = 1, ['china'] = 1, ['czech republic'] = 1, ['belgium'] = 1
            }

            local function significant(tags)
                local set, count = {}, 0
                for _, t in ipairs(tags) do
                    local isSubclass = string.sub(t.raw, 1, 1) == '#'
                    if not isSubclass and generic[t.n] == nil and not string.match(t.n, '^%d+$') and t.n ~= '' then
                        if set[t.n] == nil then count = count + 1 end
                        set[t.n] = 1
                    end
                end
                return set, count
            end

            local function sameSet(a, b)
                for k in pairs(a) do if b[k] == nil then return false end end
                for k in pairs(b) do if a[k] == nil then return false end end
                return true
            end

            local function subclassOf(tags)
                for _, t in ipairs(tags) do
                    if string.sub(t.raw, 1, 1) == '#' then return t.n end
                end
                return nil
            end

            local selectedClass = selected.CarClass
            local selectedTags = tagsOf(selected)
            local category = knownCategory(selectedTags)

            if category ~= nil then
                log('category: ' .. category)
                return function(tested)
                    return strutils.equals_i(selectedClass, tested.CarClass) and knownCategory(tagsOf(tested)) == category
                end
            end

            local sigSet, sigCount = significant(selectedTags)
            if sigCount > 0 then
                log('no known category, comparing meaningful tags')
                return function(tested)
                    if not strutils.equals_i(selectedClass, tested.CarClass) then return false end
                    local testedTags = tagsOf(tested)
                    if knownCategory(testedTags) ~= nil then return false end
                    return sameSet(sigSet, (significant(testedTags)))
                end
            end

            -- 3) Fall back to the # subclass (Kunos style).
            local subclass = subclassOf(selectedTags)
            if subclass ~= nil then
                log('no category or meaningful tags, using subclass: ' .. subclass)
                return function(tested)
                    return strutils.equals_i(selectedClass, tested.CarClass) and subclassOf(tagsOf(tested)) == subclass
                end
            end

            -- 4) Nothing to go on: single-make race with the selected car.
            log('can’t detect category, using the selected car only')
            local selectedId = selected.Id
            return function(tested)
                return tested.Id == selectedId
            end
